title: Privacy, exports, and workspace deletion
summary: Control who sees project information and export or delete a workspace.
excerpts: Workspace content is private to studio members unless it is published to a client's project portal. A client invitation grants access to that project's published content only.

Workspace owners can download a ZIP export from Settings > Data while the workspace is active. It contains project records in JSON and copies of uploaded files. Export any records you need before deleting the workspace.
The workspace owner can request deletion in Settings > Data. Deletion revokes workspace and portal access. Backups containing deleted data expire within 30 days.
